normalization_plan.reason: The receiver parameter only carries the destination address for relayTokens and has no independent semantic meaning
The value parameter is consumed directly by the relay flow and should be merged into relayTokens
The token parameter uniquely identifies the token being handled by handleBridgedTokens
The sender parameter is only meaningful inside the ERC677 callback onTokenTransfer
The callback data parameter is only used by onTokenTransfer to derive an alternative receiver
The message id parameter is only used to select the failed message in fixFailedMessage
The fee parameter is validated and stored exclusively by setFee
The fee type parameter only selects the fee slot written by setFee
The address parameter is the inserted element of addRewardAddress
Local token alias exists only inside onTokenTransfer
Local valueToMint is a temporary of executeActionOnBridgedTokens
Local fee is a temporary computed inside executeActionOnBridgedTokens
Local balance snapshot exists only inside _relayTokens
Local nextAddr is the loop cursor of _distributeFee
